sourceTitle: CBDT e-Filing ITR-3 Validation Rules AY 2026-27
notes: Rules for FY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27) under the Income-tax Act, 1961 transitional framework prior to full cutover to the Income-tax Act, 2025.
assumptions: Taxpayer is an individual resident below 60 years of age filing under transitional rules for FY 2025-26.
Standard deduction under New Tax Regime is ₹75,000.
Standard deduction under Old Tax Regime is ₹50,000.
Section 87A rebate applies up to ₹7,00,000 under New Regime and ₹5,00,000 under Old Regime.
4% Health & Education Cess applies to total tax liability.
limitations: Transitional provision valid for FY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27) only under the legacy 1961 Act.
Excludes surcharge (>₹50L), special-rate incomes, capital gains, and corporate provisions.
For tax years commencing 1 April 2026 onward, the Income-tax Act, 2025 must be referenced.
disclaimer: This calculator uses the rules/data published by Income Tax Department (CBDT) for FY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27). Estimated result based on the inputs and assumptions provided. Educational tool only; not legal, tax, or filing advice. Check official guidance for your specific situation.
